result.summary: 本文介绍了 Llama 3 系列基础模型，包括 8B、70B 和 405B 三个参数规模的多语言语言模型，原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用 [S1.p3]。最大的模型是 405B 参数的稠密 Transformer，上下文窗口最高 128K tokens [S1.p3]。论文进行了广泛的实证评估，发现 Llama 3 在大量任务上达到与 GPT-4 等领先模型相当的质量 [S1.p6]。作者公开释放了预训练和后训练版本的 405B 模型以及 Llama Guard 3 安全模型 [S1.p7]。论文还通过组合式方法将图像、视频和语音能力集成到 Llama 3 中，这些多模态模型仍在开发中，尚未广泛发布 [S1.p8]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在开发一组名为 Llama 3 的基础语言模型，原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用 [S1.p3]。作者认为开发高质量基础模型有三个关键杠杆：数据、规模和管理复杂性，并试图在开发过程中优化这三者 [S1.p4]。此外，论文还探索通过组合式方法将图像、视频和语音能力集成到 Llama 3 中 [S1.p8]。

evidence.quote: In this paper, we present a new set of foundation models for language, called Llama 3.
The Llama 3 Herd of models natively supports multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage.
We believe there are three key levers in the development of high-quality foundation models: data, scale, and managing complexity.
As part of the Llama 3 development process we also develop multimodal extensions to the models, enabling image recognition, video recognition, and speech understanding capabilities.

method.text: Llama 3 采用标准稠密 Transformer 架构，相比 Llama 2 仅有少量修改，性能提升主要来自数据质量和多样性以及训练规模的增加 [S3.SS2.p1]。开发分为预训练和后训练两个主要阶段：预训练在约 15T 多语言 tokens 上进行下一 token 预测，随后进行长上下文预训练和退火 [S2.p2][S3.SS4.p1]；后训练通过多轮监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）将模型与人类反馈对齐 [S2.p2][S4.p1]。多模态扩展采用组合式方法，分别训练图像编码器、语音编码器以及适配器，将多模态信息集成到语言模型中 [S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: Llama 3 uses a standard, dense Transformer architecture.
our performance gains are primarily driven by improvements in data quality and diversity as well as by increased training scale.
we pre-train a model with 405B parameters on 15.6T tokens using a context window of 8K tokens.
We align the model with human feedback in several rounds, each of which involves supervised finetuning (SFT) on instruction tuning data and Direct Preference Optimization.
We train separate encoders for images and speech.
We train an adapter that integrates the pre-trained image encoder into the pre-trained language model.

experiments.text: 论文在大量标准基准上评估了预训练和后训练模型，覆盖常识推理、知识、阅读理解、数学推理、长上下文、代码、对抗评估和聚合评估等类别 [S5.SS1.SSS1.p1]。后训练模型在 MMLU、MMLU-Pro、IFEval、HumanEval、MBPP、MultiPL-E、MGSM 等基准上进行了评估 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2][S5.SS2.SSS3.p2][S5.SS2.SSS4.p1]。此外还进行了广泛的人类评估，收集了约 7,000 个提示，覆盖六种单项能力和三种多轮能力 [S5.SS3.p2]。多模态实验在图像识别（MMMU、VQAv2、ChartQA、DocVQA 等）和视频识别（PerceptionTest、NExT-QA、TVQA、ActivityNet-QA）以及语音识别和翻译任务上进行了评估 [S7.SS6.p1][S7.SS7.p1][S8.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: These evaluations cover eight top-level categories: (1) commonsense reasoning; (2) knowledge; (3) reading comprehension; (4) math, reasoning, and problem solving; (5) long context; (6) code; (7) adversarial evaluations; and (8) aggregate evaluations.
We leverage MMLU and MMLU-Pro to evaluate Llama 3’s capability on knowledge-based question answering.
HumanEval and MBPP are popular benchmarks for Python code generation which focus on relatively simple, self-contained functions.
We used this taxonomy to collect about $7,000$ prompts spanning six individual capabilities (English, reasoning, coding, Hindi, Spanish, and Portuguese), and three multiturn capabilities

We evaluate the performance of the image understanding capabilities of Llama 3 on a range of tasks spanning natural image understanding, text understanding, charts understanding and multimodal reasoning
We evaluate our video adapter for Llama 3 on three benchmarks:
We evaluate the speech understanding capabilities of our speech interface for Llama 3 on three tasks: (1) automatic speech recognition, (2) speech translation, and (3) spoken question answering.

findings.text: 实验评估表明，旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先语言模型表现相当，并接近最先进水平 [S1.p6]。较小的模型在同类参数规模中表现最佳，优于其他类似参数量的模型 [S1.p6]。Llama 3 在有用性和无害性之间实现了比前代更好的平衡 [S1.p6]。多模态实验表明，组合式方法在图像、视频和语音识别任务上表现与最先进水平具有竞争力 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
Our smaller models are best-in-class, outperforming alternative models with similar numbers of parameters.
Llama 3 also delivers a much better balance between helpfulness and harmlessness than its predecessor.
We observe this approach performs competitively with the state-of-the-art on image, video, and speech recognition tasks.

limitations.text: 多模态模型仍在积极开发中，尚未准备好发布 [S1.p8][S2.p6]。安全方面，作者承认没有任何测试能保证穷尽所有可能风险，Llama 3 仍可能生成有害内容，尤其是在英语之外的语言以及被熟练对抗性红队人员提示工程时 [S5.SS4.SSS8.p1]。人类评估可能受标注者个人偏见、背景和偏好的影响，导致结果不一致或不可靠 [S5.SS3.p5]。此外，安全基准是 Meta 内部的，作者承认这些数字无法在外部复现 [S5.SS4.SSS4.p2]。

evidence.quote: These models are still under active development and not yet ready for release.
These models are still under development and not yet ready for release.
no testing can be guaranteed to be exhaustive in identifying every possible risk.
Llama 3 may still generate harmful content due to training on various datasets, particularly for languages beyond English and when prompt engineered by skilled adversarial red teamers.
human evaluations can still be influenced by personal biases, backgrounds, and preferences of human annotators, which may lead to inconsistent or unreliable results.
we acknowledge that the numbers in this section are not reproducible externally
